title: Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale
description: 10 statements of global self-worth on a 4-point agreement scale.

holder.name: Morris Rosenberg Foundation (University of Maryland, Department of Sociology)

citation.text: Rosenberg M (1965). Society and the Adolescent Self-Image. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press.

scoring.text: Sum of the 10 items (0–30) after reversing the negatively worded items 2, 5, 6, 8 and 9. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
